```csharp
public enum ObserverSlotKind
```

Whether an observer slot ([RadialObserverSlot](../radial-observer-slot/)) orbits or keeps a fixed angle.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Orbit` | `0` | An orbit slot. It orbits automatically, rotates with a right-button drag inside the slot, and zooms with the wheel. After input stops for a set time it resumes orbiting ([RadialObserverOrbit](../radial-observer-orbit/)). |
| `Fixed` | `1` | A fixed slot. It looks from the angle given by the slot's `Yaw` and `Pitch`. |
